text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic young adult male character. Medium-length black center-parted hair with strands crossing forehead, clear blue eyes, pale skin, narrow refined face, clean shaven; black leather stand-collar zipped jacket. One centered chest-up studio ID portrait. Straight front view, eye-level camera, upright head, level shoulders, eyes looking directly at the camera, relaxed neutral closed-mouth expression. Consistent 3:4 portrait crop, full hair visible, pure white background, soft even studio lighting, realistic skin texture. Preserve a consistent individual face and hairstyle across all views. High-detail photographic skin, anatomically natural features, no watermarks, interfaces, logos or text.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Precisely correct the FIRST input portrait to match the SECOND input's framing and eye-level pose. The first image is the edit target and sole identity/clothing reference. The second is ONLY the composition template: DO NOT copy that man's facial features, hair, skin color or outfit. Preserve first man's facial identity, hair, eye color, skin tone, clothing and detail.
The first man's head is too large and too low. Reduce the head-to-chin image occupancy approximately 9%, matching template hair-top height, eye height and chin height; show a little more upper chest.
Output vertical 3:4 1086x1448, pure white background, centered nose x=50%, eyes level y=37%, bottom of chin y=63%, main hair top near y=6%. Keep both shoulders level, chest crop, relaxed closed mouth, no props, no text, one portrait.
